indicator.name: FGM prevalence, women age 15–49
indicator.description: Percentage of women age 15–49 circumcised in the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey.
indicator.expected_source: Kenya Demographic and Health Survey 2022, Key Indicators Report Table 34C
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published for all 47 counties. This canonical definition resolves the former combined FGM/child-marriage placeholder as FGM prevalence only; county denominators are retained as survey precision metadata.

observations.source_table: Key Indicators Report Table 34C — Prevalence of female circumcision by county
observations.notes: Direct KDHS 2022 Table 34C FGM prevalence point estimate for women age 15–49. Suppression of low-count circumcision-type subtables does not suppress the published overall prevalence estimate. Source denominator retained; no CI/SE fabricated and ranking is prohibited.
